summary: You turn your demo into a check that runs every beat against the running system, time the start-up of each part, rehearse twice aloud (the second without stopping), drill the failures with a calm sentence for each, and test your offline story. Run for real on the capstone, including what the check says with the service switched off.
goal: M15: run the demo twice without stopping.

items.text: Start your system from nothing and time how long each part takes
Write the demo check with one function per beat and run it
Run the full demo aloud with a timer and fill in the rehearsal sheet
Switch off one dependency, run the check, and write your calm sentence for it
Check where your model files live and what happens after a restart with no network
Run the demo twice more: the second time you do not stop
Play the Rehearsal Check game to the end and see your score
